opening_source_note: Official Sybelles opening page/tariff PDF (25/26); 26/27 press kit + Saint-Jean lift company site
score_notes: Family-oriented linked domain with marked freeride zones but no FWT/FWQ history or documented off-piste classics; touring interest lies on the Saint-Sorlin side (Aiguilles d'Arves), little from Le Corbier itself.
comments: Single fixed day price all season (59.30 in 2025/26, 60.50 in 2026/27) plus 30 EUR Saturday web promo and -10% from 21 Mar; no official km figure found so skiresort 275 km used (resort markets a higher figure); 2026/27 season 12 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027; access from Italy via Frejus tunnel and A43, no pass.

opening_source_note: Official Sybelles opening page/tariff PDF (25/26); 26/27 press kit + Saint-Jean lift company site
score_notes: Sunny plateau resort of the Sybelles, mostly groomed intermediate terrain with a few freeride zones and no competition history; touring limited to local summits (Tete de Bellard, Ouillon) with better classics reached from Saint-Sorlin.
comments: Same Sybelles pass and dates as Le Corbier; single fixed day price (59.30 in 2025/26, 60.50 in 2026/27); skiresort km used as no official km figure found; access from Italy via Frejus tunnel and A43.

opening_source_note: Official Sybelles opening page/tariff PDF (25/26); 26/27 press kit + Saint-Jean lift company site
score_notes: Highest and steepest Sybelles sector (Les Perrons 2620 m) with the domain's best lift-served off-piste; genuine touring base for Aiguilles d'Arves, Etendard and Col de la Croix de Fer classics, though no big guide scene.
comments: Village base at Plan du Moulin Express bottom station (1500 m); Col de la Croix de Fer and Col du Glandon closed in winter (dead end above the village); same Sybelles pass, dates and fixed day price as Le Corbier; skiresort km used.

opening_source_note: Official Sybelles opening page/tariff PDF (25/26); 26/27 dates and price on Saint-Jean lift company site
score_notes: Small village sector (La Chal, Charvin Express) feeding the Sybelles link, mostly groomed terrain with no freeride pedigree; touring shares the Arves valley classics but starts are better from Saint-Sorlin.
comments: Ski base is the hamlet of La Chal (1600 m), not the lower village; same Sybelles pass, dates and fixed day price as Le Corbier (sja73.com lists 1 jour 60.50 for 12 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027); skiresort km used.

opening_source_note: Official Galibier-Thabor tariff PDF 25/26 (pre-opening weekend, snow permitting); valloire.net 26/27 dates page
score_notes: Some lift-served off-piste (Crey du Quart and Setaz combes, Thabor side) but no freeride competition pedigree; well-known spring touring base for Galibier, Cerces and Aiguilles d'Arves classics (Grand Galibier, Pointe des Cerces).
comments: Col du Galibier closed in winter (access via Saint-Michel-de-Maurienne and Col du Telegraphe, kept open); 2025/26 first lifts = planned pre-opening weekend 6-7 Dec 2025 on one massif at 20 EUR, operation not independently confirmed, Valloire-only 13-19 Dec then full Galibier-Thabor 20 Dec 2025; 2026/27 pattern identical (5-6 Dec pre-opening, Valloire-only 12-18 Dec, full domain 19 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027); 2025/26 adult day 53.60; cheaper Valloire-only pass exists only in the early-season week.

opening_source_note: France Montagnes 25/26 calendar (pre-opening week, snow permitting); official 26/27 tariff PDF + valmeinier.com
score_notes: Thabor sector gives lift-served off-piste bowls and couloirs but the resort has no freeride event history; touring towards Mont Thabor and the Cerces massif is well documented, without a large guide scene.
comments: Base taken as Valmeinier 1800 (main lifts, end of road) rather than Valmeinier 1500 village; 2026/27 pre-opening week 12-18 Dec 2026 limited to the Valmeinier sector (Gros Crey), full Galibier-Thabor from 19 Dec 2026; 2025/26 planned pre-opening 13 Dec then full domain 20 Dec 2025, actual not confirmed; 2025/26 adult day 53.60; Saturday web promo 27.40/41.20.

opening_source_note: France Montagnes 25/26 calendar; official valcenis.com 26/27 (Tous en Piste 12-13 Dec 2026)
score_notes: North-facing, snow-sure domain with some off-piste under the Mont-Cenis ridge but a mainly on-piste family profile; Haute Maurienne is a major French touring valley (Vanoise classics) though the hubs are Bessans and Bonneval rather than Val Cenis.
comments: Col du Mont-Cenis closed in winter, so access from Italy is via the Frejus tunnel and Modane; base = Lanslevillard (Val Cenis le Haut gondola); 2025/26 official calendar said Sat 13 Dec 2025 while one aggregator says 14 Dec; valcenis.com domain page says 12 Dec 2026 but its pass page says Sunday 13 Dec 2026 for the discount week; 2025/26 adult day about 49.50 (skiresort); 6-day+ passes add one day at each other Haute Maurienne Vanoise resort.

opening_source_note: valfrejus.ski season dates (25/26 pass page; 26/27 pass page 19 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027)
piste_km_basis: Valfrejus area; day pass also valid at La Norma (135 km, shuttle)
score_notes: Locally reputed for steep larch-forest and Punta Bagna (2737 m) off-piste on north-facing slopes, but a small area without competition history; touring limited to Mont Thabor and Frejus valley routes.
comments: Closest FR2 resort to the Frejus tunnel exit (about 10 km above Modane); 2025/26 adult day 43.00; free shuttle to La Norma every 45 min and the pass is shared between the two unlinked areas; Parcs & Loisirs lists 20 Dec 2026 but the operator site says Sat 19 Dec 2026.

opening_source_note: la-norma.ski official season dates (25/26 info page; 26/27 tariff page 19 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027)
piste_km_basis: La Norma area; day pass also valid at Valfrejus (135 km, shuttle)
score_notes: Car-free family resort whose off-piste is limited to tree runs between pistes below the 2750 m summit; Vanoise touring is nearby but the resort itself is not a touring base.
comments: Car-free resort at 1350 m with a free underground car park at the entrance (5 km above Villarodin-Bourget); 2025/26 adult day 43.00; Saturday web promo 31 EUR; 2026/27 keycard 2 EUR extra.

opening_source_note: leskarellis.com official ticketing site (25/26 season 20 Dec-11 Apr; 26/27 tariff page 19 Dec-10 Apr)
score_notes: North-north-east facing area that promotes secured off-piste inside the domain (Fontagnoux, Chaudannes) and holds snow well, but small and little known; touring possible above 2000 m yet with little variety.
comments: Car-free resort at 1600 m above Montricher-Albanne, park at the resort entrance; 2025/26 adult day 35.00; official top 2520 m (skiresort 2482 m); official km given as 60 km groomed (one English page says 65 km); cheapest day pass in the batch.

opening_source_note: bonneval-sur-arc.com 25/26 dates (20 Dec-24 Apr); lift company site 26/27 (19 Dec 2026-24 Apr 2027)
score_notes: Small but high (1800-3000 m) north-facing lift-served off-piste from the 3000 m T-bar (Vallonnet, Andagne) with very reliable snow; Haute Maurienne touring mecca (Albaron, Ciamarella, Ouille Noire, Ecot valley, Col de l'Iseran) with an active guide bureau.
comments: Col de l'Iseran closed in winter, dead-end valley reached from Lanslebourg (Mont-Cenis pass also closed); 2026/27 1-day 38.20 at the window and 37.20 online; 6/7-day passes valid across Haute Maurienne Vanoise (350 km); only 25 km of pistes (inclusion basis is altitude/touring); official top 3000 m vs skiresort 2947 m; base = La Pierre Fendue car park by the lifts.

opening_source_note: SATA skipass.alpedhuez.com news (25/26) and homepage (26/27: 5 Dec 2026-25 Apr 2027)
piste_km_basis: Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine pass (only standard pass)
score_notes: Rubric 4.0 example: big lift-served off-piste (Sarenne/Pic Blanc glacier, Combe du Loup, Grand Sablat, Vaujany and Oz couloirs) with an established guide scene; Grandes Rousses touring (Etendard, Col de la Pyramide, Pic Blanc) is documented but the resort is not a touring hub.
comments: 2025/26 pass grid uses period tiers, high season 20 Dec 2025-10 Apr 2026 adult day 66.00 (progressive pricing by period, not dynamic); 2026/27 day price not yet visible (JS ticketing site); a snow-dependent early weekend 29-30 Nov 2025 was floated but no confirmation found, official opening 6 Dec 2025; from Italy either Frejus tunnel-Grenoble or Montgenevre-Briancon-Col du Lautaret (kept open in winter, storm closures possible).

opening_source_note: Grand Domaine dates from SATA site; France Montagnes lists Vaujany 6 Dec 2025
piste_km_basis: Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine pass (only standard pass)
score_notes: Vaujany sector (Dome des Rousses 2800 m, Montfrais) offers steep, less-tracked off-piste inside the Grand Domaine; touring towards the Grandes Rousses, Etendard and Col du Sabot is documented and the village is quieter than Alpe d'Huez.
comments: Village at 1250 m with a large cable car to L'Alpette/Dome des Rousses (base = cable-car station in the village); type reflects glacier terrain reached via the linked Grand Domaine (Sarenne), none in the Vaujany sector itself; Grand Domaine pass is the standard product and sector-only passes were not verified; 2026/27 day price not yet published.

opening_source_note: Grand Domaine dates from SATA site (25/26 news, 26/27 homepage); skiinfo confirms 5 Dec 2026
piste_km_basis: Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine pass (only standard pass)
score_notes: Oz's Poutran gondolas give direct access to Grand Domaine off-piste (Vaujany couloirs, Alpette, Sarenne) but the resort itself is small and family-focused; local touring options are limited.
comments: Purpose-built Oz station at 1350 m (marketed as Oz 3300), gondolas to L'Alpette and Alpe d'Huez; type reflects glacier terrain reached via the linked Grand Domaine; Grand Domaine pass is the standard product and sector passes were not verified; webcam page sits under the summer path but is the live multi-cam page; 2026/27 day price not yet published.

opening_source_note: Official 25/26 calendar (France Montagnes, resort sites); les2alpes.com 26/27 dates (28 Nov 2026-2 May 2027)
score_notes: Strong lift-served off-piste (Vallons de la Selle, Vallons du Diable, Chalance, Dome de la Lauze descent towards La Grave with a guide) and a big guide scene; the brief's rubric names Les 2 Alpes as a 4.0 touring example (Ecrins access, Vallon de la Selle, Pied Moutet).
comments: No autumn glacier opening since 2023, winter now starts late November; 2025/26 planned opening 29 Nov 2025 not independently confirmed as operated; official 'Hiver 2027' skipass page lists SKIPASS JOURNEE adult 68.00 (skiresort shows 66 for 2025/26); official top 3600 m is a marketing figure, skiresort gives 3523 m; family/tribe passes use period tiers (avant saison, saison 19 Dec-9 Apr, fin de saison); Supernova pass adds Alpe d'Huez and La Grave; glacier skiing continues to early July.

opening_source_note: skipass.com news 26 Nov 2025 (partial opening from Pipay); Parcs & Loisirs 26/27 round-up (provisional)
score_notes: Marked but ungroomed 'Freeski' itineraries (Vallons du Pra, Combe de Bedina couloirs) and self-described largest freeride area around Grenoble; Belledonne touring (Refuge de la Pra, marked ascent route Les Fanges) with many documented day tours but modest altitude.
comments: Dynamic pricing online (0-10% off day and 4-hour passes); 2026/27 grid: high season (weekends, holidays, school breaks) adult day 45, low season Mon-Fri 42; base = Prapoutel (Gresivaudan side), Le Pleynet (Haut-Breda via Allevard) is an alternative base; 2025/26: 2 lifts at Pipay from 27 Nov 2025 then weekend openings, full season from 20 Dec 2025; top elevation from skiresort (official site gives no figure); official 26/27 dates not yet online.

opening_source_note: franceinfo 27 Nov 2025 (pre-opening that weekend); Parcs & Loisirs 26/27 round-up (provisional)
score_notes: Mainly on-piste Grenoble day-trip resort with limited off-piste (Casserousse, Lacs Robert sector); very popular local Belledonne touring with marked ascent routes but little variety or altitude.
comments: 2025/26: pre-opening weekend 29-30 Nov 2025 then continuous opening 6 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026 (official); official 26/27 dates not yet online, skiresort shows 28 Nov 2026 while Parcs & Loisirs gives 5 Dec 2026; base = Recoin 1650/1750 (Croix de Chamrousse gondola); day-pass discount for online purchase; 2026/27 day price not yet published (ticketing SPA).

opening_source_note: Grenoble Mag 18 Nov 2025 (planned pre-opening, snow permitting); tourist office offer page 26/27
score_notes: Low-altitude Vercors forest resort with little lift-served off-piste; Vercors plateau touring (Grande Moucherolle, Cornafion, Pic Saint-Michel) is popular from Grenoble but snow-dependent.
comments: 2025/26 planned pre-openings 29-30 Nov and 6-7 Dec 2025 then continuous from 13 Dec 2025 to 29 Mar 2026, actual pre-opening not confirmed; official offer page says 13 Dec 2026 (a Sunday) while Parcs & Loisirs says 12 Dec 2026; main base Cote 2000/Les Glovettes car park (1150 m) above Villard; 2025/26 adult day 43 from skiresort/aggregators, operator (SEVLC) price page is JS-only; Corrençon (Clos de la Balme) is the second entry.
